chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has fulfilled the obligatory duty or the voluntary prayer.

If he has fulfilled the obligatory duty, he is free to pray the voluntary prayer; but if he has not fulfilled the obligatory duty, he should not pray the voluntary prayer until he has prayed the obligatory duty.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying voluntary prayers before completing the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) ruling that obligatory prayers must be completed before voluntary ones, emphasizing the hierarchical priority of *fard* over *nafl* in Shia jurisprudence. This principle underscores the theological concept that fulfilling the primary covenant with God takes precedence over supererogatory devotion, a view supported by the broader Quranic emphasis on establishing prayer as a fundamental duty.
